hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (called from createReservationItems_ inside reserveInventoryStep's per-item lock) checks each reservation entry alone against available_quantity and never sums entries that share an (inventory_item, location) level. Two carts that each hold WIDGET on more than one line should both pass the per-line check against the same 10 units, so the reservations exceed stock and no_oversell should fail in some runs. Cart A (5 units) and cart B (3 piece + 2 two-pack = 7 units) total 12 against 10 stocked, so at least one oversell is expected under together timing.
